# tfctl CLI overview

The tfctl CLI is a command-line interface that allows you to manage HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise. You can integrate tfctl with your LLM agents to support AI-assisted workflows.

## Introduction

Use tfctl to manage Terraform workspaces, runs, and variables with named subcommands. Integrate tfctl with your AI agent to give it access to the HCP Terraform API and schema through the `tfctl api` subcommands. The tfctl CLI simplifies authentication, workspace management, and API interactions, allowing you to integrate HCP Terraform into your automation pipelines and development workflows.

## Get started

Complete these steps to start using tfctl:

1. **Install tfctl**: Install the CLI on your system. Refer to [Install tfctl](/terraform/tfctl-cli/install) for instructions.

1. **Authenticate**: Authenticate tfctl to your HCP Terraform account. Refer to [Authenticate with HCP Terraform](/terraform/tfctl-cli/authenticate) for instructions.

1. **Configure your environment**: Set your default organization. Replace `<ORGANIZATION_NAME>` with the name of your HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise organization.

   ```shell-session
   $ tfctl profile set default_organization <ORGANIZATION_NAME>
   ```

1. **Verify your setup**: Test your configuration by listing workspaces for your organization.

   ```shell-session
   $ tfctl get workspaces
   ```

1. **Enable AI agent integration**: If you use an AI agent, install the tfctl skill. Refer to [Install AI agent skill](/terraform/tfctl-cli/install#install-ai-agent-skill) for instructions.

## AI agent integration

The tfctl CLI is designed to work with AI agents such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Bob, and others. When you install the tfctl skill for your agent, you can use it to manage HCP Terraform resources with natural language, create automation for complex workflows across workspaces, organizations, and instances of HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise, and provide context-aware suggestions for Terraform operations.

The skill provides your agent with documentation and examples, a requirement to get confirmation for destructive operations, and structured output for parsing and decision-making.

To enable AI agent integration, refer to [Install AI agent skill](/terraform/tfctl-cli/install#install-ai-agent-skill).

## Contributing

The tfctl CLI is open source. To contribute to the project or build from source, visit the [tfctl-cli repository on GitHub](https://github.com/hashicorp/tfctl-cli). The repository includes detailed developer documentation, contribution guidelines, and instructions for building from source.
